parts.text: Mike decides he wants to replace his movie collection with digital versions.
He has 6000 movies.
A third of the movies are in various series and he knows he can get those for only $60 of the cost of a normal movie by just buying the series together.
40% of the remaining movies are older movies which are priced at $50.
How much does replacing the movies cost if a normal movie costs $100?

parts.text: Mike is planning to digitize his film library.
He owns 600 films.
He can purchase digital versions of a third of these films, which are part of various series, for just 40% less than the price of a regular film by acquiring the series as a whole.
The remaining films include 40% that are classics and can be bought for $5 each.
If the regular price of a film is $10, what will be the total cost for Mike to convert his entire film collection to digital?
